cohort: Postpartum mothers in the postnatal and post-operative wards of Assela Referral and Teaching Hospital, Ethiopia, who completed exit interviews.
finding: The prevalence of immediate postpartum LARC uptake was 35.3%, with factors such as having four or more children, cesarean delivery, prior LARC awareness and use, contraceptive counseling, and partner discussions about contraceptives being significantly associated with its uptake.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was significantly associated with higher immediate postpartum LARC uptake (AOR: 2.14).
